topic: Sensor data and MQTT broker status check
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on checking the operational status of sensor data transmission and the MQTT broker. It was noted that a specific individual, Julien Drozdz (Ingénieur reseaux et sécurité - JC Decaux), upgraded sensors to an unapproved version (53) across 167 devices.

Multiple checks confirmed that the MQTT broker was functioning correctly and that sensor data was being received (e.g., from device 001E423588CB). 

[me] inquired about flags observed in the packets, specifically asking if version 53 also switches Wi-Fi channels. [p8] confirmed that channel switching is disabled by default for this version.
decisions: The MQTT broker was confirmed to be operational and holding up.
